scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/tx-6/core build && bun run --cwd packages/tx-6/react build && bun run --cwd packages/tp-7/core build && bun run --cwd packages/tp-7/react build && bun run --cwd packages/op-1/core build && bun run --cwd packages/op-1/react build
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build && bun run smoke
scripts.pack: rm -rf packed && mkdir packed && (cd packages/tx-6/core && bun pm pack --destination ../../../packed) && (cd packages/tx-6/react && bun pm pack --destination ../../../packed) && (cd packages/tp-7/core && bun pm pack --destination ../../../packed) && (cd packages/tp-7/react && bun pm pack --destination ../../../packed) && (cd packages/op-1/core && bun pm pack --destination ../../../packed) && (cd packages/op-1/react && bun pm pack --destination ../../../packed)
scripts.sites:build: bun run --cwd sites/tx-6 build && bun run --cwd sites/tp-7 build && bun run --cwd sites/op-1 build
scripts.sites:deploy: bun run --cwd sites/tx-6 deploy && bun run --cwd sites/tp-7 deploy && bun run --cwd sites/op-1 deploy
